note: Every external input of the build and the hosted workflow: version, source, SHA-256 and license. Read by cmake/CrdPins.cmake, scripts/pins.py and scripts/check-pins.py; contract in docs/design/pinned-inputs.md. Refresh an entry by editing it here only.

boost.note: The Boost 1.92.0 release (the publisher's manifest names commit afdfa32505af73e3d208144b3f623f0096cb62b6, created 2026-08-05; the archive is not commit-addressed, so the commit is not a url field). Header-only use, compiled only into crd-bench-boost-peer, the peer library of the special-function, distribution, interpolation and odeint boards; never into an engine module or a default build. LICENSE_1_0.txt read from the archive: Boost Software License 1.0.

hptt.note: HPTT, Paul Springer's tensor transpose (no release tag; the commit of the permute board's earlier local clone). Its four sources are compiled only into crd-hptt and crd-bench-hptt-peer, the permute board's peer library; never into an engine module or a default build. LICENSE.txt read from the archive: BSD-3-Clause, (c) 2018 Paul Springer.

pocketfft.note: pocketfft's C++ header (the cpp branch's head on 2026-10-31; the project tags no release), compiled only into crd-bench-pocketfft-peer, the FFT and DCT boards' peer library, without its thread pool; never into an engine module or a default build. Before this pin the boards read an unversioned copy from ~/fft_refs (header SHA-256 prefix 2e88a5b0addf); this commit's header is 518a95c552ae. LICENSE.md read from the archive: BSD-3-Clause, (c) 2010-2018 Max-Planck-Society.

highway.note: Google Highway's library (hwy, by its own CMake with tests, examples, contrib and install off), linked only into crd-bench-highway-peer, the dispatch-cost board's peer library (ADR-0134 §8); never into an engine module or a default build. LICENSE read from the archive: dual-licensed, Apache License 2.0 or the BSD 3-Clause License, at the user's choice.

tracy.note: Tracy Profiler's client (public/TracyClient.cpp), compiled only into crd-diag-overhead-tracy, the DIAG.11b peer harness (docs/bench/2026-10-26-diag-11b-tracy-peer.md); never into an engine module or a default build. LICENSE read from the archive: BSD-3-Clause, (c) 2017-2026 Bartosz Taudul. The client bundles rpmalloc (public domain), moodycamel's concurrentqueue (Simplified BSD), Erik Rigtorp's SPSCQueue (MIT), LZ4 (BSD-2-Clause) and libbacktrace (BSD-3-Clause, Free Software Foundation).

sde-windows.license: Intel Simplified Software License (Licenses/; third-party programs in Licenses/third-party-programs.txt)
sde-windows.note: Intel's published SHA-256 (matched by the archive the user approved on 2026-10-27); the emulator of the avx512 kernel arms (ADR-0134 §8), installed whole by scripts/install-sde.py.

sde-linux.license: Intel Simplified Software License (Licenses/; third-party programs in Licenses/third-party-programs.txt)
sde-linux.note: Intel's published SHA-256 (matched by the archive the user approved on 2026-10-27); the emulator of the avx512 kernel arms (ADR-0134 §8), installed whole by scripts/install-sde.py.

mold-linux.note: The release build of tag v3.0.0 (commit 8de38c35a2df16a25f7ff87ac3ad07156a925beb, which the binary's --version names); the opt-in linker of docs/design/build-performance.md, installed by scripts/install-mold.py.

clang-build-analyzer.note: Tag v1.6.0's commit, built from source into a user directory by scripts/install-clang-build-analyzer.py (CMake, the host compiler) to read -ftime-trace profiles (docs/design/build-performance.md#compile-time-profiles); a developer tool, never shipped. Bundled under src/external: cwalk (MIT), inih (BSD-3-Clause), enkiTS (Zlib), flat_hash_map (BSL-1.0), llvm-Demangle (Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception), simdjson (Apache-2.0 OR MIT), xxHash (BSD-2-Clause), cute_files (Zlib OR Unlicense).

clang-tidy-linux.note: PyPI's clang-tidy wheel (ssciwr/clang-tidy-wheel); 20.1.0 is its only LLVM 20 release. The strict-analysis gate checks the LLVM major only (scripts/cerid_dev/environment.py), so it stands in for the hosted lanes' 20.1.8 on Linux developer hosts; installed into a user directory by scripts/install-clang-tidy.py (the binary and clang's builtin headers, laid out as bin/ and lib/clang/20/include so the binary finds its resource directory); a developer tool, never a lane step and never shipped. The binary and headers are LLVM's (Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception), the wheel's packaging Apache-2.0.

tracy-capture-windows.note: The v0.14.1 release's Windows tools (tag commit 30997d5ca6bb632cc10807a1da8a6d3de0aeeb3c, the tracy package's), the peer board's capture client: scripts/diag-overhead.py --tracy-tools extracts and verifies it and connects it to a crd-diag-overhead-tracy process on localhost (the Linux lane's through WSL2's localhost relay). A measurement tool, never a lane step and never shipped.

tracy-csvexport-windows.note: The same release archive's trace reader: scripts/diag-overhead.py counts each connected capture's zones and messages with it, so a connected arm is held to every event it emitted.

ninja-windows.note: Ninja 1.11.1, the version seanmiddleditch/gha-setup-ninja v5 installed by default before the workflow replaced that Node 20 action (2026-10-26); installed by scripts/install-ninja.py, which checks the archive, the binary and `ninja --version`. The release assets predate GitHub's recorded digests; the SHA-256 values were computed from the downloaded release files.

ninja-linux.note: Ninja 1.11.1, the version seanmiddleditch/gha-setup-ninja v5 installed by default before the workflow replaced that Node 20 action (2026-10-26); installed by scripts/install-ninja.py, which checks the archive, the binary and `ninja --version`. The release assets predate GitHub's recorded digests; the SHA-256 values were computed from the downloaded release files.

llvm.note: LLVM's Windows x64 release archive (GitHub's recorded digest matches); the hosted clang-tidy lane's strict-analysis tool, installed by scripts/install-clang-tidy.py: only bin/clang-tidy.exe and clang's builtin headers, laid out as bin/ and lib/clang/20/include. Its clang-tidy.exe is byte-identical to the developer host's C:/LLVM-20.1.8 (checked 2026-10-26). Replaced KyleMayes/install-llvm-action, which has no Node 24 release.

genmc.note: Built from source by scripts/install-genmc.py against the runner's apt LLVM of llvm_major (llvm-20-dev, clang-20; the exact package versions are recorded with dpkg-query). Parts of lli/Runtime are LLVM 3.5 derived under NCSA as well as Apache/MIT.

node-linux-x64.note: Node.js 24 LTS (Krypton, 2026-10-14) for the dashboard publisher only: ci/dashboard/generate.py publish runs the wrangler version locked with every transitive integrity hash in ci/dashboard/package-lock.json. Downloaded and hashed 2026-10-30; matches nodejs.org SHASUMS256.txt.

bake-python-windows.note: The own-CI Windows image bake (ci/executors/gce_vm.py) installs it for all users; 3.12.10 is the last 3.12 release with a Windows installer, the series the hosted workflow's setup-python uses. Downloaded and hashed 2026-10-31; Authenticode-signed by the Python Software Foundation.

bake-git-windows.note: The own-CI Windows image bake installs it silently; the digest is GitHub's recorded asset digest, checked against the download.

bake-cmake-windows.note: The own-CI Windows image bake installs it on the system PATH; the same release as bake-cmake-linux-*. The digest is GitHub's recorded asset digest, checked against the download.

bake-cmake-linux-x64.note: The own-CI x86-64 Linux image bake unpacks it under /opt and links its binaries into /usr/local/bin. The digest is GitHub's recorded asset digest, checked against the download.

bake-cmake-linux-arm64.note: The own-CI ARM64 Linux image bake unpacks it under /opt and links its binaries into /usr/local/bin. The digest is GitHub's recorded asset digest, checked against the download.

bake-vs-buildtools-windows.license: Microsoft Visual Studio Build Tools license terms
bake-vs-buildtools-windows.note: The Visual Studio 2026 Build Tools bootstrapper that https://aka.ms/vs/18/stable/vs_buildtools.exe resolved to on 2026-10-31; Authenticode-signed by Microsoft. It installs the stable channel's current toolset at bake time; the image census records the installed version (see unpinned.note).

bake-gpu-driver-installer-windows.note: Google's NVIDIA driver installer for Compute Engine Windows machines, commit-addressed; the own-CI Windows GPU image bake runs it. The driver it downloads is the one Google publishes for the machine's GPU; the image census records the installed driver. Downloaded and hashed 2026-10-31.

unpinned.note: OS-provided by the pinned runner image; the Linux lanes record the installed versions with dpkg-query into the lane census (llvm-20-dev, clang-20, g++-14 and libedit-dev only on the linux-clang-tsan entry, for the GenMC build; ninja-build, clang and libclang-rt-18-dev only on the linux-arm64 lanes, whose image runs no x86-64 pinned Ninja). The MSVC toolset comes from the pinned Windows image and is recorded by the evidence bundle. The own-CI images (ci/executors/gce_vm.py) take their apt packages at bake time, and their Windows image takes the Build Tools from the stable channel of the pinned bake-vs-buildtools-windows bootstrapper; each records the installed versions in its image census.
